description: Report a problem with a component or the registry. It goes to your own issue desk — a Durable Object holding your reports — which reproduces it via fundi, drafts an issue body including what the reproduction actually returned, and logs it to fundi. fundi files the GitHub issue with its proposed fix in it and tracks that issue afterwards, so action 'get' shows where yours got to: filed, picked up, closed. Use 'list' to see your earlier reports and 'retry' to re-attempt one that drafted but could not be logged. Your history is included in each new issue, because a repeated complaint from one reporter is often one bug. Needs sign-in: the desk belongs to your Mzizi console user.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to filing a new report.

reportId.description: Report id. Required for actions 'get' and 'retry'.

skill.description: fundi skill to run for the reproduction. fundi never infers a skill from text, so omit this to let the report kind choose one.

name: mzizi_report_issue
title: Report an issue
